title: 瑞士否决千万人口上限提案 经济避险成功 移民议题仍存争议
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What are the implications of this vote going forward for policy?
segments.zh: 这次投票对未来政策有何影响？

segments.en: Well, the message to draw from this is definitely that immigration is and will stay a polarizing issue in Switzerland.
segments.zh: 从中得出的信息是，移民在瑞士仍将是两极分化的问题。

segments.en: That is definitely the takeaway, but on the other hand, Switzerland's dodge the bullet here.
segments.zh: 这是明确的结论，但另一方面，瑞士躲过了一劫。

segments.en: So, the big Swiss corporates, Rose, UBS, ABB and so on, they will keep the access to foreign labour.
segments.zh: 瑞士大企业如罗氏、瑞银、ABB等，将继续获得外国劳动力。

segments.en: They can still recruit workers abroad, which they, before the vote, have said, is absolutely vital for them.
segments.zh: 他们仍可在海外招聘员工，投票前他们表示这对他们至关重要。

segments.en: So, the economic fallout is averted, but yes, going forward, voters will still ruminate
segments.zh: 经济影响得以避免，但选民仍会思考移民问题。

segments.en: on the issue of immigration. Okay, so the project fear the economic argument won in this case, but where does it leave
segments.zh: 这次经济论据获胜，但这对瑞士与欧盟的新协议有何影响？

segments.en: the new deal on relations with the EU that Switzerland's going to be voting on next year or in 2028?
segments.zh: 瑞士将于明年或2028年就该协议进行投票。

segments.en: This is the big question. The supporters of the population kept the Swiss People's Party, which is the right-wing party here, and the biggest party in the parliament also.
segments.zh: 支持人口上限的瑞士人民党誓言要反对该协议。

segments.en: They have vowed to fight this deal, and they have also vowed after the defeat.
segments.zh: 他们在失败后也誓言要继续斗争。

segments.en: They suffered yesterday. They have vowed to hear the Swiss People's concerns and continue to fight against what they say is misguided immigration policy of the country.
segments.zh: 他们昨日受挫，誓言倾听瑞士人民关切，继续反对其所谓的国家错误移民政策。
